lines.text: [excited] This boy is the weakest hunter on Earth. He sells tea for ten rupees a glass. But anyone who drinks his tea becomes unstoppable, for exactly one hour.
[warm] Hello friends, I'm Manoj. Today is something new: our very own webtoon, The F-Rank Tea Seller. Here is episode one.
[mysterious] It is the year twenty thirty-one. Gates to monster dungeons have opened in every city on Earth. Hunters go in, and they come out rich.
And right next to the biggest Gate in Mumbai, there is a tiny tea stall.
[funny] This is Arjun. He is eighteen years old, and his hunter rank is F, the lowest rank there is. Business is slow.
Then a famous team walks past. Their leader is Viktor, a B-Rank hunter with two million followers and zero manners.
[funny] Viktor points at Arjun and laughs. Look, everyone, it's the F-Rank tea boy!
Holding the glass like it is poison, he asks: tea from an F-Rank? Is it poisoned with weakness?
[warm] Meera, the healer, is the only nice one on the team. She pays for three teas.
Viktor drinks it in one gulp and says, nothing special.
[mysterious] But look at Arjun's face. He smiles and thinks: one hour. That's all you get.
[serious] Inside the dungeon, things go wrong fast. Ogres and monster wolves attack from the dark.
Their tank goes flying, and his shield cracks in half.
Viktor gets cut. These monsters are far too strong for level nine.
[shocked] And then, his body starts to glow. Golden power fills his hands. What is this power?
[excited] One swing, and the giant ogre is gone.
[funny] His team can't believe it. Did he just one-shot it?
Viktor thinks he has finally awakened. For fifty-eight minutes, he cuts through every monster in the dungeon.
[serious] Then they reach the boss, a giant minotaur with an axe the size of a car.
Viktor jumps in for the final hit, and the clock reaches sixty minutes.
[funny] The golden light fades away. His sword just bounces off the armor. Oh no.
So they do the smartest thing a hunter can do. They run.
They crawl out of the Gate, barely alive.
[shocked] Viktor storms back to the tea stall and grabs Arjun. What did you put in that tea?
[funny] And Arjun, totally calm, says: cardamom.
[funny] And Meera just asks: can I get one to go?

[mysterious] That night, Arjun looks at his secret skill. Hunter's Chai. Anyone who drinks it borrows great power, for exactly one hour. And he thinks: ten rupees for an hour of power? I'm undercharging.
[mysterious] But deep inside the Gate, a giant red eye opens. Something has noticed his tea.
[warm] You can read episode one free on WEBTOON. The link is in the description. A new episode comes every Thursday. So tell me in the comments: what do you think is inside the Gate?
